summary: Blocked: this commit changes only documentation and test code; the executable implementation is unchanged. The replacement steiner_tree_spans_terminals test in tests/quickcheck.rs tests each connected component separately, and the documentation clarifies the connected-graph requirement. No eligible implementation reversal exists; reproducing the corrected test behavior would require reversing test code, which is prohibited. No tests were executed.
